title: Hardware-Aware Neural Dropout Search for Reliable Uncertainty Prediction on FPGA
problem: Existing dropout-based Bayesian Neural Networks employ uniform dropout across layers, leading to suboptimal performance. Manually optimizing dropout configurations for various applications is error-prone and labor-intensive.
motivation: Uncertainty estimation through dropout-based Bayesian Neural Networks is essential for trustworthy AI in critical decision-making applications.
method: The framework uses one-shot supernet training combined with an evolutionary algorithm for efficient dropout optimization. It introduces a layer-wise dropout search space to enable automatic design of heterogeneous dropout configurations. Both the dropout-based BayesNN architecture and its FPGA hardware implementation are co-optimized to find Pareto-optimal designs.
key_novelty: Joint optimization of dropout-based Bayesian Neural Networks and their FPGA implementations using heterogeneous layer-wise dropout search.
contributions: Novel neural dropout search framework that automatically optimizes dropout configurations and FPGA implementations
Layer-wise dropout search space enabling heterogeneous dropout designs across network layers
One-shot supernet training with evolutionary algorithm for efficient optimization
FPGA designs achieving up to 33× higher energy efficiency compared to GPU implementations

metrics.accuracy: higher algorithmic performance vs SOTA FPGA designs

primary_theme: hardware-aware neural architecture search for uncertainty estimation
